meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides Open App, Sign Up, Prime and Follow; blurs or hides thumbnails, titles and chat; hides counts, avatars, badges, panels
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, real Chrome over CDP: iPhone UA 390x844 on m.twitch.tv (Home, /directory/all, a live channel) and desktop UA on www.twitch.tv (Home, a category page, several live channels). Counts below are `querySelectorAll` on the live DOM; the fixtures are sanitised excerpts of it (in desktop-live-channel.html the player, stream title and chat box wrappers, the Follow button and the Live Channels sidebar section are hand-written so data-keep can mark what no rule may hide).

LIVE phone Home (48 cards): `article img.tw-image` 48, `article > button:has(.tw-aspect)` 40, `article h3` 48 (also blurs category names), `.tw-media-card-stat` 48, `article div:has(> a > .tw-avatar)` 48, `[aria-label^="Tag, "]` 107, `a[href="/activity"]` 1, collection rows 4, Open App 1, Sign Up 1. LIVE phone /directory/all: tag pills 24, cards 8. LIVE phone live channel: chat-scroller 1, Subscribe 1, Follow 1, sda-wrapper 1.

LIVE desktop Home: `article img.tw-image` 7, `.tw-media-card-stat` 6, `.side-nav-card__live-status` 10, preview-card-avatar 6, `.side-nav-section:has([data-test-selector="recommended-channel"])` 1, `[data-test-selector="featured-item-image"]` 5 (the carousel pictures, outside `article` and without the tw-image class), front-page-carousel 1, #side-nav 1, Prime 1, signup 2, tag pills 31, category row 1, collection row 1. LIVE desktop live channel: chat-scroller 1, chat-column 1, chat-badge 20 and chat lines 22 (after "Show more"), `.community-highlight-stack__card` 1 (a Prediction card), tip callout 1, community-points-summary 1, #live-channel-about-panel 1, .channel-panels 1, similarity section 1, recommended section 1, animated-channel-viewers-count 1, Follow 1, Subscribe 2, stream-information 1.

SOURCE (community lists): uBlock users hide the sidebar list with `www.twitch.tv##div[aria-label="Recommended Channels"]` (blog.drale.com); the Adblock Plus list "Twitch: Pure Viewing Experience" (DandelionSprout/adfilt) hides `.community-highlight-stack__card` (the Hype Train banner), `.community-highlight-stack__backlog-card` and `.recommended-channels`; the "Peaceful Twitch" userscript hides `.side-nav-card__live-status` and the carousel viewer counts, which is what viewer-counts does.

Choices: thumbnails Show/Blur/Hide, stream-titles Show/Blur, chat-style Show/Dim/Blur (opacity 0.35 / blur 4px); Hide live chat wins. No rule matches on text; classes are design-system names (tw-image, tw-avatar, tw-aspect), never hashed Layout-sc-*.

NOT verified: signed in; phone chat messages and badges (the phone chat renders no chat lines logged out); hover previews; Hype Train and raid cards (same stack class as the live Prediction card); the Prime extension dock on ext.twitch.tv and the Drops pages; other locales. Video ads play inside the player and are not hidden.
